mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, compressing valuation multiples and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods show no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals labor market slack that suppresses wage growth and corporate profit margins, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in UNRATE > 4.5 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in concurrent HOUST/GDPC1 decline periods show no significant negative mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO below 100 for 3 months) reduces production capacity and increases input costs, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in INDPRO < 100 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts trend (HOUST increasing for 3 months) indicates strengthening consumer confidence and residential investment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in rising HOUST periods show no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% for 3 consecutive months signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL > 2.5 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in concurrent PAYEMS decline/UNRATE rise periods show no significant negative mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle labor market tightness (UNRATE below 4.0% for 6 months) suppresses wage growth and increases corporate labor costs, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in UNRATE < 4.0% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
